subject.title: fix(cron): preserve rescheduled reminders after gateway restart

question: After redacted real Gateway restart proof and a clean current-head shard run are available, should this maintainer-labeled cron compatibility fix merge as the follow-up to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/114569?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the change intentionally alters recovery behavior for persisted reminder state during upgrades and restarts.

options.title: Merge after runtime proof
options.body: Accept the focused repair once a redacted real restart transcript demonstrates future and overdue replacement behavior and the current head passes its affected CI shard.

options.title: Request a narrower follow-up
options.body: Keep the existing merged ownership fix and ask for a smaller PR if maintainers prefer to separate cron recovery semantics from the CI-shard registration.

recommendation.title: Merge after runtime proof
recommendation.body: Accept the focused repair once a redacted real restart transcript demonstrates future and overdue replacement behavior and the current head passes its affected CI shard.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the merged active-run ownership work and this narrowly related restart-recovery follow-up.
